summary: Changing an existing agent's harness with agents start discards the previous provider's model, effort and native arguments instead of applying them to the new provider.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire contract changes. Same-harness updates preserve existing options. Explicit options supplied with a harness replacement configure the new provider.

recovery.detail: Existing declarations are unchanged until agents start is invoked.
